<?php
class AliasParent135 {
    public int $value = 7 {
        &get { echo "G|"; return $this->value; }
    }
}
class AliasChild135 extends AliasParent135 {
    public int $value = 11;
    public function __destruct() { echo "D|"; }
}
echo "A:";
$child = new AliasChild135;
$alias =& $child->value;
echo $alias === 11 ? "alias11|" : "bad-initial|";
$alias = "12";
echo $alias === 12 ? "typed12|" : "bad-typed|";
$copy = $child->value;
$alias = 13;
echo $copy === 12 ? "copy12|" : "bad-copy|";
echo $alias === 13 ? "alias13|" : "bad-alias|";
unset($child);
$alias = "free";
echo $alias === "free" ? "free|" : "bad-free|";
echo $copy === 12 ? "copy-still12|Z|" : "bad-copy-after|";

<?php
class BindParent135 {
    public int $value = 7 {
        &get { echo "G|"; return $this->value; }
    }
}
class BindChild135 extends BindParent135 {
    public int $value = 11;
    public function __destruct() { echo "D|"; }
}
echo "R:";
$child = new BindChild135;
$replacement = 17;
try {
    $child->value =& $replacement; // REBIND
    echo "bad-rebind|";
} catch (Error $error) {
    echo $error->getMessage() === "Cannot assign by reference to overloaded object" ? "blocked|" : "bad-message|";
    echo $error->getLine() === 15 ? "line|" : "bad-line|";
    echo $error->getFile() === __FILE__ ? "file|" : "bad-file|";
}
echo $child->value === 11 ? "kept11|" : "bad-property|";
$replacement = 19;
echo $child->value === 11 ? "separate11|" : "bad-rebound|";
echo $replacement === 19 ? "rhs19|" : "bad-rhs|";
unset($child);
echo "Z|";

<?php
class WriteParent135 {
    public int $value = 7 {
        &get { echo "G|"; return $this->value; }
    }
}
class WriteChild135 extends WriteParent135 {
    public int $value = 11;
    public function __destruct() { echo "D|"; }
}
echo "W:";
$child = new WriteChild135;
$child->value = 15;
echo $child->value === 15 ? "read15|" : "bad-read|";
$alias =& $child->value;
echo $alias === 15 ? "alias15|" : "bad-alias|";
$alias = 16;
echo $child->value === 16 ? "read16|" : "bad-write|";
unset($child);
echo "Z|";
